name: Share Language, Communal
body:
Share Language, Communal
Source Ultimate Combat pg. 243
School divination; Level arcanist 3, bard 2, cleric 3, druid 3, hunter 3, mesmerist 2, occultist 3, oracle 3, psychic 2, skald 2, sorcerer 3, warpriest 3, wizard 3
Casting
Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a page from a dictionary)
Effect
Range touch
Targets creatures touched
Duration 24 hours
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)
Description
This spell functions like share language, except you divide the duration in 1-hour increments among the creatures touched.
